data.name: Amrutha
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the name Amrutha refers to the elixir of immortality. The gods were churning the ocean (Samudra Manthan) to obtain the nectar of immortality, Amrutha. The name Amrutha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amruta’, meaning nectar. The name is considered auspicious and is given to babies to bless them with a long and healthy life.
